MenuSettings.title: Fu Hey
GeneralNotes: All Main Dish served with Boiled Rice or Fried Rice or Chips 20p Extra. Unless stated otherwise.
Add Hot 20p Extra. Add Mushroom or Green Pepper or Onion 30p Extra. Add Cashewnuts £1.00 Extra.
To the best of our knowledge we do not use suppliers who deal in GM foods. Please inform us if you have any food allergies.
